newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on devaluation.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7450/7490 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday following its downward adjustment against the U.S. dollar

The central bank announced on Sunday a readjustment of the taka to 43.55/75 against the U.S. dollar from 43.10/30. The local unit opened in a wide range at 43.72/43.75 per dollar but deals were done mostly at 43.7460/7470 level. Dealers said easing of call rates had prompted demand for the greenback from importers. Call money traded at 6 to 6.5 percent against the previous 9-12 percent.
